title: Diwali 2026 Dates: Dhanteras November 6 to Bhai Dooj November 11
excerpt: Lakshmi Puja is Sunday, November 8, 2026. Here are the verified India dates for all five observances — plus the one adjustment US readers need: Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj fall a day earlier in the US, UK and Canada.
body:
• Lakshmi Puja, the main Diwali observance, falls on Sunday, November 8, 2026, in India and, for the main evening puja, on the same calendar date in the United States.
  • The festival week opens with Dhanteras on Friday, November 6, 2026, and runs through Govardhan Puja on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, and Bhai Dooj on Wednesday, November 11, 2026 — all dates for India.
  • For readers in the US, UK and Canada, Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj fall a day earlier, on November 9 and 10, 2026, according to Drik Panchang-based calendars — check your local panchang before booking travel.
  • New Delhi's Lakshmi Puja muhurat on November 8 is 5:54 p.m. to 7:50 p.m. IST, according to Drik Panchang; US readers should use the muhurat for their own city's sunset, not convert the Delhi time.

The five days, with dates

Diwali is not a single day but a sequence of five observances, and in 2026 they stretch across six calendar dates in India because the lunar tithis do not line up neatly with civil days. Jagran Josh, summarising the central government's notified calendar and published puja windows, lists Diwali itself as a gazetted holiday on Sunday, November 8, 2026. Vedantu's guide, citing Drik Panchang, gives the same five dates, and its explanation for the gap day is the same: Amavasya, the tithi that fixes Diwali, begins at 11:27 a.m. on November 8 and runs until 12:31 p.m. on November 9, so it is present at evening Pradosh Kaal on the 8th — which is why Lakshmi Puja is on the 8th, not the 9th — and Govardhan Puja moves to the 10th.

Friday, November 6, 2026 — Dhanteras (Dhanatrayodashi). The week opens with worship of Dhanvantari, Lakshmi and Kubera, and the customary buying of gold, silver or utensils. The Delhi puja window published by Jagran Josh is 6:02 p.m. to 7:57 p.m. IST.

Saturday, November 7, 2026 — Choti Diwali. The day is kept as Kali Chaudas and, in many calendars, Choti Diwali, with evening lamps. One technical note from the Drik Panchang-based guides: the Naraka Chaturdashi dawn ritual (the pre-sunrise oil bath) falls on the morning of Sunday, November 8 this year in the Delhi calendar, which is why some sites list Choti Diwali observances across both days.

Sunday, November 8, 2026 — Diwali and Lakshmi Puja. The main day. Families perform Lakshmi-Ganesha puja in the evening, light diyas and share sweets. For New Delhi, the muhurat is 5:54 p.m. to 7:50 p.m. IST, inside a Pradosh Kaal of 5:31 p.m. to 8:09 p.m., according to figures attributed to Drik Panchang in both guides above.

Tuesday, November 10, 2026 — Govardhan Puja (Annakut). Monday, November 9 is the gap day in India this year. Govardhan Puja, marking Krishna lifting Govardhan hill and kept with the Annakut offering of food, is on the Tuesday, with a Delhi morning window of 6:39 a.m. to 8:51 a.m. IST in the Jagran Josh table.

Wednesday, November 11, 2026 — Bhai Dooj. The week closes with the sibling observance, when sisters apply tilak to brothers. The published Delhi tilak window is 1:10 p.m. to 3:21 p.m. IST.

What changes if you are reading in the US

The main night carries over cleanly: Lakshmi Puja is on Sunday, November 8, 2026 in the United States as well. The tail of the week does not. HinduTone's Drik Panchang-based guide notes that in the USA, UK and Canada, Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj fall a day earlier than in India — on Monday, November 9 and Tuesday, November 10, 2026 — while Australia, New Zealand and Singapore follow the India dates. Diaspora families planning a temple visit, a day off work, or a Bhai Dooj call across time zones should plan on the US dates, not simply copy the India calendar.

The other planning rule is about time, not date: a muhurat is tied to local sunset. Do not convert Delhi's 5:54 p.m. IST window into your time zone. Use a panchang calculated for your own city, as both the India guides and the diaspora guide advise.

Planning notes

Because Diwali falls on a Sunday in 2026, the Jagran Josh report notes that regular central government offices and educational institutions in India will already be marking the weekend, and some state governments have notified extended local holidays around Dhanteras and Govardhan Puja. For diaspora readers, the practical window for travel or family gatherings runs from Friday, November 6 through the US Bhai Dooj on Tuesday, November 10. For the stories and regional traditions behind each day, see our companion piece, How India Celebrates Diwali: Five Days of Lamps, Legends and Regional Traditions.
nri_angle: Lakshmi Puja is Sunday, November 8, 2026 in both India and the US, but Govardhan Puja and Bhai Dooj fall a day earlier in the US, UK and Canada — November 9 and 10 — so diaspora families should plan on their local panchang dates.
author: Diaspora Desk
